text: [shocked] On Tuesday, one little update knocked Apple offline!
[fast] iCloud signed people out. Apple Pay stopped paying. The App Store wouldn't load.
Brand-new iPhones just said... [deadpan] unable to activate.
[laughs] Even Apple's own stores couldn't sell anything.
[deadpan] And the status page? Still green.
Apple says it wasn't hackers. [curious] It was their own internal update.
[playfully] Did your phone act weird today? Send this to the friend who blamed their Wi-Fi.
